name: Light Propagation Maps
definition: LPM is a Discrete Ordinate Method (DOM) technique that approximates the radiative transfer equation by using fine sampling for iterative light propagation and coarse sampling for storage to reduce memory usage and artifacts like false scattering and ray effects.
summary: Light Propagation Maps is a discrete ordinate method that minimizes false scattering by decoupling spatial and directional sampling using high-resolution 2D maps and coarse 3D grids.
